jobs.description:
We are looking for an engineer who wants to build the foundation of our new Integrations effort: the connectors that bring our customers' data from third-party systems into the Trackunit platform. The connectors you build directly support our new partnership business, one of our key goals for next year. You will be among the first developers on this project, designing a reusable architecture and working directly with the engineers behind the systems we connect to, as well as seeing customer feedback shape what you build next. You might have a couple of years or be an experienced senior engineer, either way, we would be interested in seeing your application for this role.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Shape how the work gets done. Join a new, small team set up next to an established platform team, and help define how integrations get built here.

• Hear directly from the people using what you build. Customer feedback feeds straight back into the roadmap, and we act on it quickly.

• Collaborate beyond your own codebase. You’ll have regular, technically focused conversations with developers from the systems we connect to.

• Learn from experts who share. You’ll work with experienced domain experts who are open to sharing what they know, so you learn quickly.

• See your work ship. We favour small, frequent releases over long project cycles, so progress is visible fast.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend developer with strong Java skills, just as comfortable at the edges where systems meet as inside your own codebase.

• Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and REST APIs, in particular consuming data from other systems, in a microservice architecture.

• Experience designing new, reliable, reusable architecture for integrating with multiple systems. System-to-system integration experience is what we value most.

• You are comfortable discussing technical feasibility and approaches with third-party technical teams.

• You care what happens when data moves between systems, so you build with quality, observability and reliability in mind and you know quickly when something breaks.

• You are motivated by incremental delivery, enjoy getting close to the data, and like building new foundations from scratch.

You embrace AI as part of how you engineer. From prototyping through to production, you use AI tools as an integrated part of your workflow, not as a shortcut but as a force multiplier. That said, this isn't the main thing we're hiring for: curiosity and a willingness to use it well matter more than deep prior experience.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Design a reusable architecture for integrating with multiple third-party systems, not one-off solutions.

• Build connectors that collect data from third-party systems, usually ERPs, mainly by consuming their REST APIs, and bring it reliably into our platform.

• Understand the data you collect and transform it into Trackunit's data model.

• Work with third-party vendors: discuss technical feasibility and approaches with their technical counterparts.

• Build with quality, observability and reliability in mind, on our microservice and event-driven architecture.

****Our hiring process

****Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a lead engineer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

Are you passionate about GMP compliance, and comfortable navigating a cross-functional environment with many different stakeholders?

We are looking for a Senior Compliance Professional to strength compliance our Engineering organization.

In this role, you will be a trusted advisor, driving deviations, CAPAs, SOP updates, change controls, and compliance initiatives while partnering closely with engineers, managers, and quality stakeholders.

**About The Team

**You will be part of a larger organization with multiple teams and broad cross-functional collaboration.

You will report to the Head of Site, Engineering, and the role is based at our manufacturing site in Kvistgaard, Denmark.

**About The Role

**You become an important partner to colleagues in Engineering and work closely with stakeholders across Quality Assurance, Quality Control and MSAT. The role therefore combines solid GMP understanding with coordination, collaboration and the ability to drive activities forward.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Drive Engineering deviations and ensure robust root cause analysis and sustainable solutions

• Lead and support CAPAs, SOP updates, Change Controls, and other compliance activities

• Drive compliance improvement projects and License-to-Operate initiatives

• Ensure inspection readiness and support audits and regulatory inspections

• Monitor compliance KPIs and act as a trusted compliance sparring partner for Engineering teams and management

**Qualifications

**To succeed in this role, we imagine you have:

• Master’s degree (Engineering, Life Sciences, or similar)

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience working in a GMP-regulated environment

• Experience with deviations, CAPAs, Change Controls, and quality systems

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills

• A proactive mindset with a passion for driving improvements and fostering a strong compliance culture

• Full proficiency in English and Danish

**Why join Bavarian Nordic?

**You will join an international company with unique technology and colleagues who share a passion for making a difference.

We offer:

• A visible role with an opportunity to make an impact in a collaborative organization

• A supportive team, flexible working conditions, and opportunities to develop your procurement expertise

• A competitive compensation package, pension scheme, health insurance, and bonus opportunities

• A high-quality canteen with a wide selection of meals and take-away options

• Fitness discounts, a massage scheme, and an active staff club offering social and sporting events

**Salary

**Annual base salary range: DKK 585,000 to 716,000 gross

At Bavarian Nordic, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. The final base salary within this range will be determined based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, and competencies, as well as internal pay equity.

**Caught your interest?

**Join us and help ensure operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement in a dynamic Engineering environment.

Please note that for this position, we do not support any relocation packages. Candidates must possess a legal basis to work and reside in Denmark.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

__Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

_For more information, visit _www.bavarian-nordic.com

**About The Role

**At FLS, we have simplified our business and strengthened our profitability in recent years. We are now shifting our focus to accelerating profitable growth. To steer this journey, we are establishing a Corporate Growth Office that leads our strategic growth and profitability initiatives in close cooperation with our Business Lines, Group Functions and other stakeholders.

As Director, Corporate Growth Office and Strategy, you will build and run the engine that turns our strategic ambitions into owned, tracked and delivered results. You will own the portfolio management, governance and operating rhythm of the Corporate Growth Office. This spans the monthly Growth Office reviews in our Executive Leadership Team and in each Business Line performance review. You will also connect the initiative portfolio to our corporate strategy process. As deputy to the Head of Corporate Growth Office, you will be a trusted sparring partner to Business Line Presidents, Finance and initiative owners.

Reporting to the Head of Corporate Growth Office, you will join a small, high-calibre team at our headquarters in Copenhagen. Around 80% of the role is dedicated to running the Corporate Growth Office and around 20% to corporate strategy work. The Growth Office enables, challenges and connects: our Business Lines own the delivery of their initiatives, and you will make sure it happens with pace, rigour and transparency.

**What You Gain

**This is a rare opportunity to build a Growth Office from the ground up at a pivotal moment for FLS, and to shape how a global industrial company steers its growth. You will gain:

• Close collaboration with our CEO, the Executive Leadership Team and Business Line Presidents and Business Line management teams.

• An enterprise-wide view of how FLS creates value across Business Lines, Group Functions, sales areas and our mergers and acquisitions (M&A) agenda.

• Visible impact, as your work shows directly in our results and in how we work together as one FLS.

• A broad platform for your professional development, combining growth office leadership with corporate strategy.

• The chance to help the mining industry move towards a more sustainable future.

**You will play a key role in

**_Setting up and running the Corporate Growth Office

_

• Designing and embedding the Growth Office operating model with the Head of Corporate Growth Office, including governance forums, roles and decision rights, the stage-gate process, value rules and reporting standards.

• Turning our corporate management model into a working operating rhythm, including the monthly Growth Office review in the Executive Leadership Team and the Growth Office segment of each monthly Business Line performance review.

• Building an in-house playbook and capability, so that FLS eventually runs its growth agenda with its own people, tools and routines.

_Managing the growth portfolio

_

• Owning one Group-wide view of growth workstreams and initiatives, with clear owners, milestones, value targets, risks and interdependencies.

• Running the stage-gate process from idea to realised value, including gate-readiness checks and rigour tests before key decisions.

• Keeping the pipeline healthy through quarterly re-prioritisation and backfilling of initiatives, and spotting off-track initiatives early.

_Executive governance and reporting

_

• Preparing decision-ready material for the Executive Leadership Team and Business Line leadership on value delivered against plan, value at risk, stage-gate decisions and blockers.

• Maintaining decision and action logs, driving follow-up and escalating issues that need executive attention.

• Contributing to Executive Leadership Team and Board updates and to the messages cascaded to the wider organisation.

• Deputising for the Head of Corporate Growth Office in executive forums.

_Value tracking with Finance

_

• Defining the baselines, impact categories and validation rules that make reported value credible, together with Group and Business Line Finance.

• Reconciling initiative value with forecasts, budgets and actual results every month.

• Rolling out and governing a common initiative-tracking software platform as the single source of truth.

_Partnering with Business Lines and Group Functions

_

• Acting as the Growth Office’s lead partner for selected Business Lines and Functions and challenging the ambition, pace and quality of their plans.

• Helping each Business Line establish its own Growth Office cadence in line with our common practice.

• Coordinating cross-Business Line and cross-functional initiatives, and supporting the integration of acquisitions into the growth portfolio.

_Corporate strategy

_

• Supporting the annual strategy process and preparing strategy material for the Executive Leadership Team and the Board.

• Translating strategic and financial targets into Business Line growth ambitions, key performance indicators (KPIs) and initiative portfolios.

• Leading selected strategic analyses, such as market and competitor insights, growth levers and business cases.

_Building capability and a performance culture

_

• Training initiative owners and Business Line Growth Office leads in our ways of working, methods and tools.

• Working with Communications and People & Culture on the growth narrative, success stories and recognition.

• Promoting transparency, accountability and fact-based decision-making across the organisation.

**To succeed in the role, you

**_Experience and education

_

• Have at least eight years of professional experience, including several years with a leading management consultancy, or equivalent.

• Have hands-on experience of setting up and running a transformation, growth or program management office end to end, ideally in a growth or commercial transformation and not only in a cost program.

• Have led or steered large, cross-functional initiative portfolios with direct exposure to CEOs, executive teams and boards.

• Bring experience of strategy work, such as translating strategic targets into initiatives and KPIs; experience of running a corporate strategy process or M&A integration is an advantage.

• Ideally bring experience from industrial, capital goods, mining, energy or other business-to-business companies with a strong service business.

• Hold a master’s degree in business, economics, engineering or a related field; an MBA is an advantage.

_Knowledge and skills

_

• Know the mechanics of a well-run growth office: stage gates, value tracking and validation, governance cadence, performance dialogues and tracking tools.

• Have strong financial acumen, including profit and loss logic, business cases, baselines and impact validation, and work naturally with Finance.

• Understand commercial growth levers such as pricing, sales effectiveness, aftermarket and service growth, and product and portfolio management.

• Create clear, concise and decision-ready material and storylines in PowerPoint and Excel; experience with strategic program management tools is an advantage.

• Are fluent in English; other languages are an advantage.

_Personal qualities

_

• Have the executive presence and credibility to challenge senior leaders constructively and to influence without formal authority.

• Are highly structured, rigorous and detail-oriented, while staying pragmatic and focused on what moves the needle.

• Stay resilient and composed under pressure and in ambiguity.

• Are collaborative and inclusive, with a coaching mindset and a ‘one FLS’ attitude.

• Act with integrity and discretion when handling sensitive information.

• Are based in, or willing to relocate to, Copenhagen, and are able to travel when needed.

• Have a genuine interest in FLS, our customers, the mining industry and our MissionZero ambition.

Total salary range incl. variable pay: DKK 1,220,000–1,800,000 per year.

• The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

For more information about the role, please contact Anssi Poutanen, Head of Corporate Growth Office, at Anssi.Poutanen@FLSmidth.com. We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

As an equal opportunity employer, FLSmidth embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply - the more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is. In our commitment to equal opportunity and eliminating bias, we kindly request that you exclude personal information such as age, ethnicity, marital status, number of children, and photographs from your application materials.

FLSmidth is a full flowsheet technology and service supplier to the global mining industry. We enable our customers to improve performance, lower operating costs and reduce environmental impact. MissionZero is our sustainability ambition towards zero emissions in mining by 2030. We work within fully validated Science-Based Targets, have a clear commitment to improving the sustainability performance of the global mining industry and aim to become carbon neutral in our own operations by 2030. – for more information please visit FLSmidth.com/careers

We offer all employees access to a dedicated recognition platform, empowering you to celebrate achievements, share appreciation and stay connected globally.

The world needs more minerals, and they are becoming harder to produce. FLS works alongside mining companies as their performance partner, helping them increase output, improve recovery and maximise uptime. Through full flowsheet technologies, aftermarket services and digital solutions, we improve productivity while reducing energy and water consumption, enabling more sustainable mining operations. www.fls.com

jobs.occupation: Data Engineer - Design, build and scale the foundations of data and AI
jobs.description:
**Location: Copenhagen (please note this job requires onsite presence - remote work not possible)

**Do you want to work hands-on with modern cloud-based technologies, data engineering and AI, while helping turn complex data into solutions that create real business value?

Join us as a Data Engineer to become part of an environment where knowledge is shared, and curiosity is encouraged. And work with tools such as Snowflake, dbt, Claude, Microsoft Azure, SQL and AI as you help develop the data platform that enables actionable insights, intelligent solutions and data-driven applications.

“You’ll get to contribute to solutions for a wide portfolio of customers - without compromising on flexibility and work-life balance. This also allows you to develop your expertise through challenging assignments and collaboration with experienced colleagues,” says Brian Landbo, Manager, SmartX.

**Join an environment built around knowledge, collaboration and growth

**At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we believe that development happens when people learn and solve challenges together. You will become part of our ambitious and agile SmartX team where the pace is high and where we work with modern cloud technologies, data engineering, analytics and AI through our data platform.

**Develop our cloud-based data platform

**As a Data Engineer, you will work closely with analysts, developers and business stakeholders, play a central role in developing our cloud-based data platform, and help transform complex data requirements into robust solutions that deliver real value. You will work across data engineering and AI, while contributing to the foundations that make intelligent and data-driven solutions possible.

**More Specifically, You Will

**

• Develop and maintain data models

• Develop, optimize and quality-assure data pipelines in Snowflake

• Implement transformations, tests and documentation using dbt

• Ensure high data quality through automated testing and validation processes

• Work with Medallion Architecture and modern data warehouse principles

• Support the development of AI-based solutions and data-driven applications

**Experience With The Main Technologies

**You do not need to tick every box. We believe some of the best colleagues grow through curiosity, commitment and a genuine desire to learn. We are looking for a new colleague who enjoys solving complex problems and who is motivated by both technology and the value it can create. You thrive in a collaborative environment where professional dialogue and knowledge sharing are an important part of everyday work. And you enjoy continuously learning and exploring new technologies within data, AI and cloud platforms.

**Finally, We Imagine That You

**

• Have hands-on experience with and a solid understanding of Snowflake as a cloud data warehouse

• Have strong SQL and data modelling skills, including experience with dimensional modelling such as facts, dimensions and star schemas

• Have experience using dbt for data transformation and ETL/ELT processes

• Have worked with data validation, automated testing and documentation

• Have experience with Git and agile development processes

**Ready to build what comes next?

**Then we are happy to hear from you and urge you to hit that “Apply Now“ button.

Apply today and make NTT DATA Business Solutions the place where you grow.

**Job Description

**Do you want to lead a team of six and shape the future of data and analytics in Danica? As Head of Business Data & Analytics, you will develop people, set direction and strengthen the link between data, insights and business value.

Your team works across business and data analytics, partnering with the business and management to turn complex challenges into actionable insights and data-driven solutions. Data is a key enabler of Danica’s strategy: your work will support better decisions, customer experiences, business performance and growth. This role combines people leadership with a strong interest in data and business, helping the team and wider organisation strengthen their use of analytics as our capabilities evolve.

**What You Will Be Doing

**You will strengthen analytical maturity and continuously develop our data and analytics capabilities. As our new data platform evolves, you will leverage opportunities enabled by the platform, AI and other emerging technologies to improve how we generate insights and turn data into tangible business value.

Your team will be a trusted business analytics partner to stakeholders across Danica, providing insights that enhance business decisions.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Lead and develop a team of six, helping them turn data and analysis into actionable business insights.

• Build strong relationships with stakeholders across Danica, acting as a trusted analytics partner while providing credible professional challenge.

• Continuously develop the team's analytical capabilities, methods and ways of working, fostering a strong analytical mindset and high professional standards.

• Collaborate with the leadership team in Data & Analytics to set direction, align priorities and strengthen how data and analytics create value across Danica.

**About You

**We imagine that you are an experienced people leader with a strong background in analytics, data or a closely related field. You do not necessarily need to be the deepest technical specialist in the team, but you should have sufficient analytical understanding to challenge, guide and develop the team.

• People leadership. You have demonstrated leadership experience and enjoy developing people. You lead with trust, curiosity and a collaborative mindset.

• Analytical expertise. You bring strong analytical expertise and act as a trusted sparring partner for the team.

• Business understanding. You understand how business questions can be translated into data use cases, analysis and actionable insights.

• Direction and delivery. You are able to set direction while balancing strategic priorities with day-to-day delivery.

• Stakeholder relationships and communication. You build strong stakeholder relationships and are comfortable constructively challenging established thinking. You communicate complex topics clearly and confidently across technical and non-technical audiences.

It is required that you are fluent in both Danish and English !

**What We Offer You

**

• Influence and impact. Shape the future of Business Data & Analytics in an area where data increasingly drives business development and decisions. Develop the team’s analytical competencies and influence how new data capabilities create business value across Danica.

• Leadership development. Genuine opportunities to develop your own leadership capabilities.

• Hybrid working. Hybrid working arrangements, typically three days per week in the office.

Interested**?

**Apply today! If you have any questions about the position, please reach out to the Head of Data & Analytics Thomas Jonsson at thjon@danica.dk . We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please apply at your earliest convenience.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Senior Technician – Mammalian Downstream Manufacturing (Night Shift)
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced downstream technician with hands-on knowledge of chromatography, filtration, and UF/DF processes? Do you enjoy working independently while sharing your expertise with colleagues?

**At AGC Biologics, we are looking for a Senior Technician to join our Mammalian Downstream Manufacturing team in Copenhagen.

You will work in a dynamic, GMP-regulated manufacturing environment where different products and customer requirements call for technical expertise, adaptability, and attention to detail. As part of the team, you will contribute to reliable production while helping strengthen the technical capabilities of your colleagues.

**About The Job

**As a Senior Technician, you will be responsible for executing downstream purification processes and ensuring that manufacturing activities are carried out safely, efficiently, and in compliance with GMP requirements.

You will work independently within your area of expertise while collaborating with colleagues to meet production goals. The role requires strong process understanding, sound judgement, and the ability to adapt to different manufacturing setups without compromising quality.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Executing downstream purification processes, including chromatography, filtration, and ultrafiltration/diafiltration (UF/DF).

• Operating chromatography systems, including UNICORN software, and applying your technical understanding during production.

• Ensuring accurate GMP documentation and compliance with approved procedures and aseptic practices.

• Supporting troubleshooting, deviation investigations, and continuous improvement activities.

• Taking ownership of your training, technical qualifications, and development.

• Sharing knowledge and providing hands-on training and guidance to less experienced colleagues.

As you become familiar with our processes, we expect you to take an active role in supporting the development of new colleagues and contributing to high standards of technical performance and GMP behaviour within the team.

**Who Are We Looking For?

**We are looking for an experienced technician with a solid understanding of downstream purification and a strong commitment to quality and compliance.

**We Imagine That You

**

• Have approximately 3–5 years of experience in GMP-regulated manufacturing, preferably within biopharmaceutical production.

• Have an educational background as a Process Operator, Industrial Technician, Biotechnology Technician, or an equivalent relevant technical qualification.

• Have hands-on experience with chromatography, filtration, and UF/DF processes.

• Have a good understanding of UNICORN chromatography systems.

• Are familiar with GMP requirements, aseptic practices, and accurate production documentation.

• Can independently execute complex manufacturing activities and contribute to solving technical challenges.

Beyond your technical experience, we value colleagues who take ownership of their work and development, maintain high standards of quality, and contribute positively to the team.

You work in a structured way, adapt to changing production needs, and willingly share your knowledge. You communicate openly and understand when to ask for support or escalate an issue rather than compromise quality or compliance.

**Working Hours

**This is a night-shift position (18:00-05:04 or 20:00-07:04) in our Mammalian Downstream Manufacturing department in Copenhagen.

You will work according to an established shift schedule (5-2 in a 14 days period) supporting our manufacturing operations.

**What We Offer

**At AGC Biologics, you will join an international biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment where technical expertise, accountability, quality, and teamwork are central to how we work.

**We Offer

**

• The opportunity to work with different products and downstream manufacturing setups, developing your technical expertise.

• A role where your experience matters, both in daily production and in supporting the development of your colleagues.

• A supportive and approachable manager who values trust, accountability, and open communication.

• A collaborative team environment where knowledge sharing and continuous improvement are encouraged.

• We offer an attractive compensation and benefits package, including pension, health insurance, and other benefits in accordance with local agreements.

• Access to our canteen arrangement, Employee Club, and employee discount opportunities.

**Interested?

**If you have experience with downstream purification and are motivated by combining technical responsibility with quality and teamwork, we would like to hear from you.

Interested?

Please submit your application and CV through our recruitment system. Applications will be reviewed continuously, and we reserve the right to close the job posting once we have found the right candidate.

**Apply today and join our Mammalian Downstream Manufacturing team at AGC Biologics.

****Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

Opoint is looking to add another talented individual to our BDR team and continue our growth!

Opoint is an industry-leading technology firm based in the Nordics and the UK. We specialise in the capture and delivery of content from over +250,000 news data sources across 135 languages and 220 jurisdictions.

Opoint’s global customer base spans many sectors, including finance, media, consulting, risk management, regulatory and compliance workflows.

Are you a door opener, a network builder and someone who enjoys engaging with prospects? Then this role is for you.

Job Description

This is an application round for a Business Development Representative (BDR) based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

We are seeking an extroverted, results-oriented BDR to communicate with global prospects across outreach channels (cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn).

You will focus on opening doors, starting relationships with international companies, and connecting them with Account Executives.

As part of Opoint’s Sales and Marketing team, you’ll have excellent opportunities to grow your career on an international and commercial track across a range of industries. You’ll build fluency in the risks and needs of each sector and engage directly with decision makers. Expect flexibility in your routine and no two days alike.

What You Do

• Work with an Account Executive Team to execute outreach strategies to engage multinational companies across various industries and markets.

• Operate in international markets, sharpening your pitching and problem-solving skills as you evaluate and match client needs to the right solution.

• Reach monthly outreach targets with the help of your team.

The Skill Set You Bring

• Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field (Business, Economics); other degree types and relevant work experience will be considered.

• Relevant B-2-B sales experience preferred; internship experience taken into consideration.

• Interest in the technology sales industry as a career path, required.

• Previous cold-calling experience, preferred.

• Experience with lead generation tools, considered a plus.

• Results-driven & competitive nature.

• Interest in exchanging verbally with new prospects and cold calling, required.

• Fluency in written and oral English is a requirement.

• Commitment to becoming a closing SaaS Account Executive, considered a plus.

• Must hold a valid working visa for Denmark.

What We Offer

• An exciting position in an international environment and ability to grow a career at the intersection of technology and business development.

• The opportunity to engage with different companies in different industries around the world.

• A fun and relaxed work environment that prioritises teamwork, communication, and flexibility while executing goals.

• A great group of colleagues in Opoint and throughout the wider ownership group.

• Flexible working hours.

• Social activities, including social clubs, sports, seasonal parties, and company events.

• Canteen arrangement.

• A premier office space at Pilestræde 58 in central Copenhagen.

Interested?

This is a full-time position, and we are looking for candidates who can start soon.

We look forward to reading your application and CV. Please note that we do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. Therefore, kindly refrain from including documents containing personal identification numbers (CPR numbers).

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Toby Cook (toby.cook@opoint.com) or Henrik Dragland (henrik.o.dragland@opoint.com) or +45 31712831 to learn more.

We encourage all qualified candidates to apply for the position regardless of age, gender, religion, or ethnic background.

Strong financial insight is essential for turning commercial activity into sustainable business performance. As our Business Controller, you will partner closely with the leadership team, providing the analysis, challenge and financial structure needed to support informed decisions and improve results across the organisation.

Your Impact

• Act as the financial business partner to the leadership across Sales, Project Management and R&D, supporting strategic and operational decision-making through financial insights and recommendations..

• Prepare and consolidate monthly performance reporting, ensuring management has a reliable view of financial and operational performance.

• Perform P&L variance analysis, identify key performance drivers and translate findings into practical actions for the business.

• Lead forecasting processes covering revenue, order intake, project performance, SG&A and annual budgeting, improving transparency and financial predictability.

• Drive financial management of projects and act as a financial partner in monthly project reviews with Project Managers, strengthening cost control, accountability and financial discipline.

• Support business case development and financial evaluation of strategic initiatives, investments and R&D projects.

• Ensure timely identification and communication of financial risks and opportunities, while providing recommendations for mitigating actions.

• Contribute to the continuous development of controlling processes, reporting tools and performance management practices across the organisation.

What Drives Success

• Relevant experience in business controlling, project controlling, financial planning, performance management or a comparable finance role.

• Strong understanding of P&L management, budgeting, forecasting, financial variance analysis and project financial management

• Ability to translate complex financial data into clear recommendations for commercial and operational stakeholders.

• Confident business partner who constructively challenges decisions and builds trusted relationships across functions.

What We Offer

• A central role influencing commercial performance and financial decision-making across NOVENCO.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you’re at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you’ll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don’t accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won’t agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

Monta is building the platform that powers the future of EV charging. We connect hardware, software, businesses, and drivers into one seamless ecosystem. Our mission is to make charging simple, reliable, and scalable for everyone.

Do you genuinely want to make an impact on people’s lives and their health? Do you have a business-oriented and analytical mindset with proven IT skills and the ability to process data and conceptualize it into interactive and visually appealing dashboards and reports? Then you might be our new colleague.

The team you will be part of

At our global HQ, located in Ballerup, Denmark, you will join a innovative and hybrid work environment. You will be part of the Agile Transformation & delivery team and work closely with the other teams within the SW & Electronics organization as well as stakeholders across the organization.

This role is an exciting opportunity to contribute to strategic initiatives and support business development through analytics and data utilization, while developing your skills in a real-world setting.

Your Contribution Is Appreciated, And You Will

• Support the organization's data needs by assisting with data management and analytics from the agile release train delivery process

• Develop, optimize and maintain data-driven analytical performance tracking dashboards and reports in Power BI / Sharepoint, as well as building the underlying data models

• Aid in ensuring high data quality, by assisting in reinforcing relevant supporting processes

• Generate and provide ad hoc reports and analyses to support the business delivery being transparent

• Actively seek out new opportunities in data and analytics with business requirements

• Automate the forecast tool embedded into our planning tools and processes

To Succeed In The Role, We Imagine That You

• Are currently enrolled as a student at a Business School or University, within the field of Data Science, Engineering, Business Analytics, Business Intelligence, Statistics or similar

• Have a genuine interest for data and analytics

• Can approach new problems with an analytical and data-driven mindset

• Have great communication and presentation skills

• Have practical experience with Power BI, MS Office, Jira, Python and SQL and/or are keen to further enhance those skills

• Are curious towards new technologies, and to learn new systems

• Are fluent in English, written and spoken

• Can work appr. 15-20 hours a week (flexible hours to fit your academic schedule)

At a personal level, you enjoy working in a team to create new solutions. You are capable of adjusting and feel comfortable working in a highly varied environment. Furthermore, you have a natural understanding of how to make things simplistic, including complex technical concepts, when interacting with stakeholders cross functionally.

We encourage you to apply

Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we will gladly receive your application if you think you have transferrable skills**. We highly value a mindset, motivation, and energy, that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider AMBU organization as well.

Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

We're now looking for a Chief Product & Technology Officer to lead our next chapter.

One accountable leader for what we build, why we build it and how we release it.

The Role:

The role translates the company’s growth ambition into an AI-first portfolio built on a scalable, secure and coherent platform, and ensures that it reaches customers predictably and at a high quality bar. The CPTO is both the architect of the portfolio and its foremost ambassador, internally and externally.

You'll own product strategy, technology, architecture and release cadence across our full product portfolio, leading an international product and R&D organization globally.

Reports to Chief Executive Officer; member of the Executive Management Team.

Direct reporst - VP of Technology Engineering; VP Product Management.

📍 Copenhagen HQ preferred

• international role, approx. 40–50 travel days a year.

What You'll Drive:

• Scale Retail platform solution for global enterprise customers and lead our entry into the US market.

• Set the direction for our next-generation hospital platform.

• Take AI from roadmap to recurring revenue, built into the core platform and delivered responsibly.

• Bring several legacy systems together into one coherent, secure cloud platform.

• Build a predictable release rhythm and a data-driven, AI-first engineering culture.

• Shape build, partner or buy decisions and lead product and technical due diligence.

Strategic Priorities:

Three agendas connect directly to growth along two vectors: winning more clinics and customers (points of sale) and expanding what each customer uses and pays for (product depth and ASP). Platform consolidation underpins all three.

• Manage: Global Scaling to Enterprise & US Market Evolve Manage for enterprise scalability, security, integrations and governance, with standardised workflows across clinics and regions. Sequence market entry deliberately rather than opportunistically.

• Next-Generation Hospital Software: Set direction for and deliver a modern, future-proof hospital platform. Define the product configuration needed for broader global expansion without compromising the depth hospital customers require.

• AI: From Roadmap to Recurring Revenue Move planned AI categories from build to commercial launch on time and to a high quality bar. Drive attachment until AI is a differentiator in every deal and a recurring contributor to ARR.

• One Coherent Platform: Reduce the number of legacy systems and build the shared foundation that makes the three agendas above deliverable.

Success Criteria:

First 6–12 Months:

• A clear, prioritised and communicated product and technology roadmap addressing 2 main Goals; Enterprise Expansion & US Market Entry, understood and supported by the Executive Management Team and the Board.

• A decided and initiated plan for next-generation hospital software, built on one coherent foundation.

• A defined target architecture and a legacy consolidation plan with milestones.

• A defined AI approach across the portfolio, with concrete initiatives linked to customer value and ARR potential.

• Clear build-versus-buy principles and a product-led view on M&A opportunities.

• A product and technology organisation with clear roles, one planning rhythm and agreed delivery metrics to increase velocity and throughput.

What You Bring:

• Senior leadership of both product management and engineering (CPTO, CPO, CTO or SVP level) in B2B SaaS or vertical software.

• A record of turning market insight into a portfolio strategy that grows ARR, including pricing and packaging.

• Experience building and leading multinational, distributed teams and developing strong leaders.

• Platform modernisation, legacy consolidation and M&A integration experience.

• Hands-on understanding of where AI creates real customer and business value.

• Credibility with engineers and in C-level customer conversations.

• PE-backed or high-growth experience is a clear advantage; healthtech or regulated industries a plus.

Personal Qualities:

• Strategic: Think in wholes, long horizons and business value, and turn this into concrete, prioritised choices.

• Technology fluent: Credible with architects and engineers, and able to explain technical trade-offs in business terms.

• Commercial: Understand the link between product, sales and earnings, and drive growth through the product.

• Execution-strong: Balance ambition with pragmatic delivery and measurable results.

• Clear communicator: Explain product and technology choices simply and convincingly, and builds buy-in from the Board to the team.

• Empowering leader: Build strong teams and develop people, in line with our values: Cutting-edge, Attentive, Resourceful, Ethical/Transparent.

• Purpose-driven: Motivated by improving access to hearing healthcare.

• Robust: Collaborative, and able to make clear choices when priorities compete.

How We Work:

Agile, direct and non-political. We say it like it is, make the tough calls and like to see people grow and deliver results. Our values are all about C. A. R. E. - Cutting-edge, Attentive, Resourceful, Ethical/Transparent.

What We Offer:

A central value-creation role in an Insight Partners-backed software company with an ambitious growth plan and a clear purpose. The CPTO owns the full product and technology agenda, takes a defining role in the growth journey, and has access to Auditdata’s Management Incentive Programme.

Your journey with us:

We want you to get to know us as well as we get to know you.

• Introductory call (online) with our Talent Partner;

• Value fit meeting (online) with our Chief People Officer, followed by a behavioural profile (such as DISC);

• Executive interview (online) with our Chief Executive Officer;

• Copenhagen visit (in-person): meet the team at our HQ and present a case on a real challenge we’re tackling;

• Final interview (online) with the Board.

Throughout, you’ll get timely feedback and plenty of room to ask your own questions.

We look forward to your application! (please submit your CV in English and why this role interests you)

Auditdata is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to create diverse work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills.

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager, Strategic Procurement Initiatives
jobs.description:
Job Description: Are you passionate about project management, and think strategy execution in a Nordic role sounds exciting? Are you motivated by driving complex initiatives across functions and countries, turning strategic ambitions into tangible business results?

If so, you could be our new Senior Project Manager in Project Management & Strategy Execution, Group Procurement.

At Tryg, Procurement plays a central role in shaping and developing our Nordic partner and supplier ecosystem. Through strategic sourcing initiatives, partnerships, and transformation projects, we help create business value, improve customer experiences, and support the delivery of Tryg’s strategic priorities across the Nordics.

About the role | Turning strategy into results

As a Project Manager, you will play a key role in executing Procurement’s strategic agenda. Through strategic sourcing projects and transformation initiatives, you will help translate ambitions into tangible results that strengthen our business, improve customer outcomes, and create measurable value across Tryg.

You will take on a Nordic role with responsibility for driving projects from initial analysis and scoping through implementation and benefit realization. Many of the projects span countries, business areas, and stakeholder groups, with Claims being one of our key partners.

Working closely with leaders, specialists, and key stakeholders across the organization, you will be responsible for creating alignment, driving progress, and ensuring successful execution across diverse perspectives, priorities, and dependencies.

Projects vary in scope and focus and may include:

• Strategic partnerships and supplier development

• Process optimization and operational excellence

• Digitalization and automation initiatives

• Cost and value creation programs

• Customer and partner experience improvements

Common to all projects is their focus on turning strategic priorities into meaningful change in how we work with partners and how customers experience Tryg.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Leading strategic projects and transformation initiatives from analysis and planning through implementation and benefit realization.

• Establishing clear project goals, plans, governance structures, and success criteria.

• Ensuring progress, quality, risk management, and dependency tracking throughout project lifecycles.

• Creating alignment and engagement among stakeholders across Procurement and the wider organization.

• Challenging existing ways of working and transforming opportunities into concrete improvements.

• Driving implementation and ensuring sustainable organizational adoption of new solutions and processes.

• Contributing to the continued development of our project management methodologies, tools, and ways of working.

We are looking for project managers with different profiles and levels of experience.

Depending on your experience and background, you will take responsibility for projects of varying size and complexity. As a Senior Project Manager, you will lead larger cross-functional initiatives and programs while also contributing to the further development of our project management capabilities.

For one of the positions, we are particularly interested in candidates with experience from the automotive industry, as several upcoming initiatives will focus on developing our workshop partnerships, spare parts ecosystem, and other key areas of the automotive value chain.

About you | Analytical, proactive, and collaborative

You are motivated by creating results through collaboration and thrive at the intersection of business, strategy, and execution. You are able to create structure in complex situations, challenge existing approaches, and turn ideas and analyses into practical solutions.

You likely hold a relevant university degree and have experience within project management, transformation, or strategic development, either from a similar role or from management consulting.

We place particular emphasis on candidates who:

• Have a proven track record of leading complex projects or transformation initiatives from analysis to implementation.

• Possess strong analytical capabilities and can translate complex challenges into clear recommendations and decision-making material.

• Work in a structured manner and take ownership of progress, quality, and outcomes.

• Have strong stakeholder management skills and can create commitment across functions, teams, and organizational levels.

• Are curious, challenge the status quo constructively, and actively seek opportunities for improvement.

• Are fluent in one of the Scandinavian languages (Danish, Norwegian, Swedish).

Experience within Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Supplier Management, or the insurance industry is considered an advantage. However, what matters most is your ability to lead complex initiatives, understand business priorities, and create measurable results.

About us | Project Management & Strategy Execution

You will join the Project Management & Strategy Execution team within Group Procurement.

Our mission is to ensure successful execution of Procurement’s strategic priorities in close collaboration with our sister team, Strategy & Innovation Hub. While Strategy & Innovation Hub focuses on opportunity identification, analysis, business cases, and benefit definition, our team is responsible for driving execution, implementation, and organizational anchoring.

Together, we ensure that strategy becomes reality.

We bring an analytical, structured, and results-oriented approach to our work, while believing that outstanding results and a healthy work environment go hand in hand. We therefore prioritize an environment characterized by high ambitions, strong collaboration, and continuous professional and personal development.

With us, you will gain:

• A highly visible Nordic role with broad stakeholder exposure.

• The opportunity to work on strategically important projects with meaningful business impact.

• Close collaboration with leaders, specialists, and decision-makers across Tryg.

• The chance to influence both the projects you lead and the future development of project management within Procurement.

We value trust, accountability, and teamwork, and we believe the best results are created together.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Please submit your application and CV no later than 22nd of November.

We encourage applicants not to include a photo in their CV.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and invite selected candidates for interviews continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The recruitment process will close once the right candidate has been identified.

If you have any questions regarding the position, please feel free to contact Jonas Klestrup, Head of Project Management & Strategy Execution, at jonas.klestrup@tryg.dk.

We encourage everyone regardless of gender identity, age, background, disability or origin to apply for the position. We are proud to have high employee satisfaction, strong professionalism and equal opportunities to develop your career in the Tryg Group. Tryg is the largest non-life insurance company in Scandinavia with activities in Denmark, Norway and Sweden. Every day we strive – each in our own way – to create peace of mind and affect the lives of most Scandinavians. Read more at www.tryg.com

jobs.occupation: Student Assistant for Analytical Method Development
jobs.description:
Would you like to work for a CDMO producing Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API) for different companies worldwide? **Do you want laboratory experience in a biopharmaceutical company? Then join AGC Biologics in a Student Assistant role and become part of an international and dynamic organization where everyone is responsible for delivering right on time as one team!

****About The Department

**We are a highly collaborative team that provides analytical support to both early-stage and late-stage development projects, as well as to external customers. Our work environment is dynamic and requires strong coordination across the team.

We are therefore looking for a Student Assistant who is communicative, flexible, positive, and service minded, and who enjoys contributing to a team-oriented environment.

**Your Responsibilities

**As a Student Assistant in the Analytical Method Development team, your primary responsibilities will include:

• Preparation of buffers and eluents

• Preparation of analytical samples (e.g. desalting and concentration)

• Ensuring reagents and buffers are prepared and available for analytical work

• Supporting the team with laboratory-related tasks

You will work closely with other team members to ensure that the laboratory operates smoothly and that materials are prepared in time for analysis.

**About You

**We are looking for a candidate who:

• Is enrolled in a relevant higher education program (e.g. Chemistry, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Sciences or similar)

• Has strong attention to detail

• Has good written and spoken English skills

• Works in a structured, accurate, and methodical manner

• Is proactive, flexible, and solution oriented

• Is comfortable working independently as well as in a team

• Has some familiarity with laboratory equipment such as analytical balances and pH meters

The role requires a consistent weekly presence of 8 hours per week, typically as one full working day. We aim to provide flexibility during exam periods and vacations where possible.

**How To Apply

**We will process the applications as they arrive and will close the job posting once we have the right candidate. Therefore, please submit your application and CV as soon as possible.

**When applying, please also attach your university enrolment letter as proof of your current student status.

**If you need further information about the position please contact Team Lead Phillip Sommer (Phillip.sommer@agcbio.com.)

**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.
